checks.label: Expected form
checks.expression: valid_code("ABC-42") is True and valid_code("XYZ-00") is True

checks.label: Reject substring only
checks.expression: valid_code("ABC-42-extra") is False and valid_code("xABC-42") is False

checks.label: Exact spelling and whitespace
checks.expression: all(valid_code(s) is False for s in ["abc-42","ABC-42 "," ABC-42","ABC-42\n"])

checks.label: Correct lengths
checks.expression: all(valid_code(s) is False for s in ["AB-42","ABCD-42","ABC-4","ABC-123",""])
